title: Google Just Gave Developers 1,000,000 Free Tokens

segments.text: Google just made one of the biggest AI giveaways for developers ever.
You can now use Gemini two point five, Flash and Pro, completely free.
That is one million tokens every single minute, at zero cost.
It natively handles text, images, audio, and video.
Getting it is simple. Just go to ai dot google dot dev.
Sign in with your Google account.
Then open Google AI Studio and grab your free key.
Follow for daily AI news and free tools.

description: Google is giving developers 1,000,000 free Gemini tokens per minute. Here's exactly how to claim it: go to ai.google.dev, sign in, open Google AI Studio, grab your free key. Follow for daily AI news!
